description: Use to discover which papers OpenRepro has checked, or find reports for a literature review by topic or outcome. For one identified paper's result, use check_paper. Search published re-runs by words in the title, authors, venue or field, optionally filtered by outcome or field. With no query, lists the whole ledger.

outcome.description: inconclusive: a registered validity/precision condition (a gate) was not satisfied, so no outcome is given; evidence_incomplete: OpenRepro's own evidence failed; abandoned: an attempt finalized during setup with no result, which only ever appears as an earlier version in a report's attempt history, so it matches no paper. None of these is a finding about the paper.

query.description: words to match; leave empty to list everything

name: search_reports
title: Search the OpenRepro ledger
